game_concept: A arcade set in Snowy Hold – Snowdrift Barracks, barracks half buried in snow: the firewood keeper must handle winter bandits while practicing functions. Core idea – Boolean Guards: Write functions returning True or False that guard checkpoints.
theme: Snowy Hold – Snowdrift Barracks: barracks half buried in snow
core_gameplay_loop: In Snowdrift Barracks, repeat each round: Write functions returning True or False that guard checkpoints. Each round, a new hot soup pots challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the guards value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 600 points of hot soup pots by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 600, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 10 (extended tier): Boolean Guards
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Boolean Guards' (Week 6 slot 10), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Snowdrift Barracks'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how guards changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against winter bandits in Snowdrift Barracks.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 600 within 46 seconds.
